en.title: Foundations of AI Safety Fellowship · LAISH
en.description: A free, in-person, 8-week fellowship in Lisbon on the risks of advanced AI and how to help. No technical background needed.

hero.title: A grounding in AI safety, in eight weeks.
hero.lede: A free, in-person fellowship in Lisbon for students and working professionals. Learn the risks of advanced AI and the practical ways you can help. No technical background needed.

weeks.label: What you will explore
weeks.title: Eight weeks, from capabilities to your next step.
weeks.intro: Six discussion weeks and two guest lectures from people who already work in AI safety. Then an optional co-working and career day.
weeks.note: Week plan from the autumn 2026 cohort.

items.title: Capabilities
items.text: How AI systems are built, measured and forecast.

items.title: Risks
items.text: Misuse, misalignment and systemic risks, and the first strategies against them.

items.title: Strategies and governance
items.text: Defence in depth, compute governance and international coordination.

items.title: Evaluations
items.text: Benchmarks, dangerous-capability tests and a deployment-board simulation.

items.title: Europe
items.text: The EU AI Act, verification and the role of middle powers.

items.title: Specification gaming
items.text: How systems pursue the wrong goal, and goal misgeneralisation.

items.title: Safety cases
items.text: Red-team a lab's safety plan, then choose your first step.

items.title: Careers
items.text: Roles in AI safety and how to make the move.

how.label: How a session works
how.title: Less lecture, more argument.
how.intro: Come with the reading done, ready to discuss and debate. Bring a laptop or tablet. An accountability buddy keeps you on track between sessions.

items.title: Small tables
items.text: You work in tables of 3 or 4 and change tables every round, so you meet everyone in the cohort.

items.title: Simulations and debates
items.text: Negotiate an international AI agreement. Sit on a lab's deployment board. Argue both sides of a question.

items.title: Readings with a tutor
items.text: The readings run on Lens Academy, based on the AI Safety Atlas, with an AI tutor for any term you get stuck on.

faq.label: Frequently asked
faq.title: Questions about the fellowship.
items: Who is this fellowship for?

Students and working professionals who live in Lisbon and want to learn about AI safety and how to contribute. If you are not based in Lisbon, or not moving here before the start, this course is not right for you. We are happy to recommend other options.
Where is the fellowship based?
All sessions are in person in Lisbon, about a 10-minute walk from Entrecampos station and ISCTE.
Can I participate remotely?
No. All participants attend in person.
Does LAISH offer financial support?
Not at this time. We cannot cover accommodation, travel or other costs. Participants already live in Lisbon and cover their own travel.
What does the coursework look like?

The material is based on the AI Safety Atlas, on a platform made by Lens Academy. Expect about 2 hours of work a week plus a 2-hour session with guided discussions and activities. Six weeks follow this format; two weeks are guest lectures from AI safety experts.
What happens after I complete the course?

You receive a certificate from Lens Academy and stay part of the LAISH community, with career guidance for life and free entry to our events. We are building mentored projects for selected graduates. The end of the fellowship is the start of our work together.

faq.label: Perguntas frequentes
faq.title: Dúvidas sobre o fellowship.
items: Para quem é este fellowship?

Para estudantes e profissionais que vivem em Lisboa e querem aprender sobre segurança da IA e sobre como contribuir. Se não vives em Lisboa, nem te vais mudar antes do início, este curso não é para ti. Teremos todo o gosto em recomendar outras opções.
Onde decorre o fellowship?
Todas as sessões são presenciais em Lisboa, a cerca de 10 minutos a pé da estação de Entrecampos e do ISCTE.
Posso participar à distância?
Não. Todas as pessoas participam presencialmente.
A LAISH dá apoio financeiro?
De momento, não. Não conseguimos cobrir alojamento, viagens ou outras despesas. Quem participa já vive em Lisboa e paga as suas deslocações.
Como é o trabalho do curso?

Os materiais baseiam-se no AI Safety Atlas, numa plataforma da Lens Academy. Conta com cerca de 2 horas de trabalho por semana e uma sessão de 2 horas com discussões e atividades guiadas. Seis semanas seguem este formato; duas são palestras de especialistas em segurança da IA.
O que acontece depois de concluir o curso?

Recebes um certificado da Lens Academy e continuas a fazer parte da comunidade LAISH, com orientação de carreira para sempre e entrada gratuita nos nossos eventos. Estamos a preparar projetos com mentoria para diplomados selecionados. O fim do fellowship é o início do nosso trabalho em conjunto.
